nodes.label: MoNy Monthly Money Tracker
nodes.rationale: A simple private offline-first personal finance tracker organized around one budget cycle at a time.

nodes.label: Offline-first local privacy
nodes.rationale: No account, server, or ads are required; user data stays in browser storage on the device and the app remains usable offline.

nodes.label: Persistent hidden-toggle view architecture
nodes.rationale: Both main views and all four tab panels stay mounted in the DOM and switch with the hidden attribute, avoiding routing and page loads while allowing render functions to remain tab-agnostic.

nodes.label: First-paint dark canvas
nodes.rationale: Critical dark canvas styling is inlined before the external stylesheet to eliminate the white flash between launch artwork and application paint.

nodes.label: Full-width spending breakdown
nodes.rationale: A stacked bar and exact-value legend replace a donut because tiny categories were unreadable and the donut consumed scarce mobile space.
